newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex to propose profit re-investment.
newsitem.headline: Cemex to propose profit re-investment.

text.p: Board members of cement giant Cemex will propose to shareholders that profits from 1996 be re-invested, the company said.

Shareholders will discuss the proposal at the company's annual general meeting here in this northern industrial city on April 24, Cemex said in statements published in local press. It did not elaborate on the re-investment plans.
Another item of the agenda will be to determine the amount Cemex will establish in reserves to buy back shares. The share buyback plan was announced recently.
